description: For one hub (business_profile or merchant_center): previews what the signed facts change there, then, with approve true, sends those items, then checks the hub against the signed copy. Each call does the next of preview, send and check and answers next_action. Sending waits for a person's approval where the key needs one.

approve.description: true sends the items the preview showed. Leave it out to preview.

idempotency_key.description: A new value for each send; the same value answers the same send.

run_id.description: The send to check, from the previous answer.

trooth_id.description: The company's trooth_id. Leave it out to use the one your key or sign-in acts for.

name: trooth_hub_sync

next_action.description: The one next call: tool (null when a person acts), arguments, label, and url where a page does it.

status.description: Set on a refusal: invalid_request, read_only, task_risk_detected or unavailable.

title: Send the signed facts to one listing hub
